items.title: Stocks slide as investors worry about data centre backlash
items.summary: Tech stocks tumbled on Wall Street Thursday on concerns over the future of AI data centre projects following the US midterm elections, wiping out gains from a post-election rally the day before.Data centres have faced broad opposition from US voters regardless of political affiliation, and many midterm winners have pledged to put the brakes on such projects, for example by imposing moratoriums on new buildouts.
